w10_P4_002091: A 6,000 g drone flies at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The drone flies at an altitude of 80 m. There are 4 drones per team and 9 teams, so the total is the per-drone value multiplied by 4 and then by 9. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002092: A 14 kg projectile flies at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 2x² at the point x = 2. Its energy of motion, less 16 J of launch loss, is converted to kJ. The range is 600 m long. Two projectiles are fired, so the report doubles the per-shot value. What does the report give, in kJ?
w10_P4_002096: The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 23 kN of structural allowance added to a combined force that is expressed in kN. The combined force is 2 N more than the sum of 10 identical hoist outputs. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 169 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 9x + 8 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002098: A rider and bike with a combined mass of 59,000 g move around a velodrome at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 4 riders from a squad of 7. A team of 3 such riders has a combined energy of motion 3 times that of one rider. The coach adds 29 J of timing offset to the team value. Eight teams race, so the meet total is 8 times the team value, and the meet total is converted to kJ. What is the meet total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002099: The total in a delivery-cart report, in kJ, is 6 times a per-cart figure. The per-cart figure is 8 J of sensor offset added to the energy of motion of one cart, with that sum then expressed in kJ. Each cart has a mass of 50 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 8x between x = 1 and x = 2. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002100: The final figure in a press-hall report is expressed in kN, converted from a plant total in N. The plant total is 3 times a hall total, the hall total is 11 times a line total, and the line total is 2 times a single-press force. A single press supplies the force needed to accelerate a 128 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 153 and 378. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002119: A 19,000 g cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller root of x² - 15x + 56 = 0. Eleven such carts form a train, so the train's combined energy of motion is 11 times that of one cart. The train runs 10 trips, so the shift total is 10 times the train value. The track is 45 m long. A 6 J sensor offset and then a 17 J calibration allowance are added to the shift total. What is the final figure, in J?
w10_P4_002125: A 25,000 g delivery robot moves at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 13x + 42 = 0. Its energy of motion, less 18 J of wheel loss, is converted to kJ. Eight robots make up a fleet, so the fleet value is 8 times that. A 30 kJ battery reserve is then added to the fleet value. What is the resulting figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002128: A 41,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. The drive must supply the force for this plus 5 N of roller friction. There are 12 such conveyors, so the plant total is 12 times the per-conveyor value. A further 12 N of allowance is added to the plant total, and the result is converted to kN. What is the result, in kN?
w10_P4_002133: A 9 kg drone's cruise speed in m/s is found by taking the greatest common divisor of 175 and 360, adding 29, and then subtracting 5. Its energy of motion at that speed is measured. The drone flies at an altitude of 150 m. The fleet has 10 drones per hangar and 11 hangars, so the fleet total is the per-drone value multiplied by 10 and then by 11. What is the fleet total, in J?
w10_P4_002140: A 114,000 g tool head on a press is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 8 and 2. The drive must supply the force for this plus 8 N of guide friction, and the total is converted to kN. The press log records a net force defined as that value minus a 24 kN return-spring load plus an 18 kN hydraulic assist, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_002141: A 23,000 g cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ - 2x² at the point x = 1. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The cart is 0.9 m long. Nine carts run, so the fleet value is 9 times the per-cart value, and 15 kJ of stored reserve is then added. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002144: The figure at the end of a crane load sheet, in kN, is 4 kN of wind allowance added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 8 identical hoists acting together. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 76 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 10x + 21 = 0. What figure ends the load sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_002145: The total in a depot's energy report, in J, is 9 times a hall total. The hall total is 9 times a line total, and the line total is 2 times a per-cart figure. The per-cart figure is 7 J of stored spring energy added to the energy of motion of a 31,000 g cart. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 4x + 3 = 0. The depot floor is 80 m long. What is the total in the report, in J?
w10_P4_002146: A 42 kg go-kart on a test track moves at a speed in m/s equal to 8 times the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. Its energy of motion is measured. The track is 400 m long. The logger subtracts 12 J of bearing loss, then adds 5 J of sensor offset, and then subtracts 21 J of air drag. What energy does the logger report, in J?
w10_P4_002151: A 20,000 g tool head on a milling machine is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ - 1·x² at the point x = 1. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. The machine log records a net force by subtracting a 20 kN clamping load, then subtracting a 13 kN brake load, then adding a 17 kN hydraulic assist, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_002153: The final figure in a sled-test report, in kN, is 11 times a session figure. The session figure is 2 times a per-run net force, with the thrust direction positive, so it may be negative. The per-run net force is a thrust expressed in kN minus an 11 kN rail-brake load. The thrust is the force needed to accelerate a 174 kg sled at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 5x³ - 5x² at the point x = 2. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002160: A 22,000 g cart runs along a lab rail. Its speed in m/s is found as follows: take the second derivative of y = 1·x³ - 6x² evaluated at x = 2, multiply it by 6, multiply again by 6, add 25, and subtract 14. The rail is 5 m long. What is the cart's energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_002161: The total in a hoist report, in N, is 8 times a single-hoist figure. The single-hoist figure is 9 N less than a subtotal, and the subtotal is 19 N more than the force needed to accelerate a 159 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 13x + 40 = 0. The hoist cable is 25 m long. What is the total in the report, in N?
w10_P4_002173: The final figure in a booster-test log, in N, is 1 N less than a subtotal. The subtotal is 26 N of margin added to the combined thrust of 7 identical boosters. Each booster supplies the force needed to accelerate a 30,000 g payload at a rate in m/s² equal to 29 more than the smaller root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. What is the final figure, in N?
w10_P4_002174: A conveyor drive in a bottling plant is being sized. The force it must supply, in N, is what is needed to accelerate a 71 kg crate at a certain rate. That rate, in m/s², is found by taking the slope of the curve y = 3x³ - 6x² at the point x = 1, multiplying it by 6, adding 13, multiplying by 2, and adding 12. What force must the drive supply, in N?
w10_P4_002181: A 7 kg parcel on a sorting conveyor moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 301 and 52. Eleven such parcels ride at once, so the combined energy of motion is 11 times that of one parcel. From the combined value, 10 J of belt loss is subtracted. The result is converted to kJ. What is the result, in kJ?
w10_P4_002183: The total in a courier-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 11 times a regional figure. The regional figure is 11 times a depot figure, and the depot figure is 10 times a per-bike figure expressed in kJ. The per-bike figure is the energy of motion of a 20 kg cargo bike moving at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 1·x² at the point x = 1. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002199: A 113 kg sled on a rocket track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 2x² at the point x = 2. The thrust needed for this is converted to kN. Four sleds run per session, so the session figure is 4 times that. Two sessions are run, so the campaign figure is twice the session figure. What is the campaign figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002204: The final figure in an energy report, in kJ, is 14 kJ of reserve added to a fleet total. The fleet total is 11 times a per-unit figure. The per-unit figure is 20 kJ of stored battery energy added to the energy of motion of an 11 kg robot, after that energy has been converted to kJ. The robot moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 85 and 231. What is the final figure, in kJ?
